About this page

This page was updated in 2020 to attempt inclusion of all bus stops per route and (abbreviated) rail route connections having been first published in November 2017 as a redesigned successor of the original At A Glance: London bus routes page first published in February 2017. Information on this page may change as a result of any inaccuracies identified.

All routes information has been adapted from TFL with additional sources of information including Wikipedia.
